scope: Results, archived raw payloads, derived analyses and unexecuted follow-up plans. No new model requests or scientific reanalysis were performed for this archival update.
source_note: Source checkout commits identify the inspected copies, not necessarily the code at collection time; frozen plans and execution files preserve original provenance.
exclusions: OS metadata and empty run.lock files in newly packaged snapshots

run_snapshots.note: Audit export contains 480 original trajectories and 1,674 cached readout measurements. This snapshot groups existing collection and readouts; it is not an additional experiment.

preservation_note: All pre-existing archives are byte-identical. Local files are never overwritten; distinct executions/snapshots are retained. New archives omit only OS metadata and transient run.lock files. Raw published payloads and copied reports are not edited. The 2026-10-18 additions preserve every uploaded archive byte, including existing empty run.lock members. Two large archives are stored as ordered 6 MiB binary parts with exact reassembly hashes. Prior failed calibrations remain failed; derived audits and the unexecuted crossing plan are labeled separately.

archive_container_aliases.note: Both original uploaded ZIP byte streams are preserved. The independent downstream audit cites the upload2 container hash; there is only one downstream-rule execution.

counting_note: Archive counts include audit bundles, plans, and both member-identical downstream-rule ZIP containers; they are not counts of independent experiments. Run snapshots can package multiple pre-existing stages. Earlier inventory scan counts remain recorded in previous_inventory.

incremental_security_scan.scope: New uploaded archive bytes, all their regular members, and selected standalone analyses were scanned; this is pattern-based screening, not a guarantee against every possible sensitive string.
